text:
maria: FYI kicking off tenant_idx_swap_v3 tonight 00:30 UTC. tagging @kevin @jenna @ops-runbooks. deploy-bot scheduled. saw higher WAL backlog in rehearsal.

samuel: ack. i'll watch replica lag + lock_hold. what's the hard abort?

jenna: Abort triggers: replica_lag > 15s OR any pg_lock wait > 12s for more than 30s. Rollback steps in runbook: pin schema_version back to v20251111_02, disable tenants.index_swap flag, and drop the new index concurrently if created. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/index-swap

kevin: Writers: we'll apply a 1-minute write-freeze during the swap. who flips?

maria: i'll flip. API: `POST /internal/flags {"flag":"tenants.index_swap","on":true}` at 00:27 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled 'tenant_idx_swap_v3' for 2025-11-12T00:30Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated health gates.

ops-runbooks: Preflight checklist: 1) confirm replica sync <5s 2) confirm WAL backlog <30s 3) dry-run lock profile. Escape hatch: abort canary, pin schema, restart writer tier, notify SRE paging.

jenna: Quick preflight SQL to approximate backfill size:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM tenants WHERE needs_new_index = true LIMIT 1;
-- expect ~95k rows
```

samuel: Starting canary watch. thresholds: warn @ 8s lag, escalate @ 12s. Lock wait >5s => pause backfill.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary step started 300Z. routing 5% traffic to new index codepath.

maria: flipped flag at 00:27 :white_check_mark:. also queued 'tenant_idx_fill' job but will pause if contention observed.

samuel: lag creeping 3s -> 7s -> 10s in 8 minutes. holding close.

jenna: reduce blast: drop canary to 2% and pause 'tenant_idx_fill' job. set safemode: `db.safemode.lock_timeout=2500ms` in canary region.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaled canary to 2% and paused job 'tenant_idx_fill'.

kevin: Noted. If locks escalate, i'll trigger `deploy-bot hold` with reason `lock_spike`. Who executes pin if we abort?

maria: i'll run the pin. SQL to pin:
```sql
UPDATE schema_versions SET active=false WHERE name='tenant_idx_swap_v3';
INSERT INTO schema_versions(name, active) VALUES('v20251111_02', true);
```

ops-runbooks: If WAL backlog > 45s, restart writer tier and wait for WAL catch-up before any rollforward. Manual signoff required to resume.

samuel: canary metrics stable at 2% for 6m: latency +2ms, 5xx count 0, replica_lag steady 9s.

jenna: decision: continue 2% for 10m. escalate if lag > 14s or any sustained pg_lock > 10s. rollback if user errors >0.3% or any surge in 5xx.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary complete at 00:48 UTC, no abort. advancing to wave2 (20%) per rollout policy.

kevin: i'll keep my hand on manual unpin. backup plan ready.

maria: adding a note to release notes: "tenant index swap: phased rollout, short write-freeze, background fill pausing on lock contention."

jenna: thanks everyone 3m — continuing watch for wave2. will call rollback if any threshold breached.
